heading.en: A potter wants rice, the farmer wants shoes
heading.kn: ಕುಂಬಾರನಿಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಬೇಕು, ರೈತನಿಗೆ ಚಪ್ಪಲಿ ಬೇಕು

hook.en: A potter wants rice. The rice farmer does not want pots, he wants shoes. Without money, the potter must first find a cobbler who wants pots. Money makes all this unnecessary.
hook.kn: ಕುಂಬಾರನಿಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಬೇಕು. ಭತ್ತದ ರೈತನಿಗೆ ಮಡಿಕೆ ಬೇಡ, ಚಪ್ಪಲಿ ಬೇಕು. ಹಣವಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕುಂಬಾರ ಮೊದಲು ಮಡಿಕೆ ಬಯಸುವ ಚಮ್ಮಾರನನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಬೇಕು. ಹಣ ಈ ತೊಂದರೆಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the problems of the barter system
State the four functions of money

narration.en: A potter wants rice. The rice farmer does not want pots, he wants shoes. Without money, the potter must first find a cobbler who wants pots. Money makes all this unnecessary.
narration.kn: ಕುಂಬಾರನಿಗೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಬೇಕು. ಭತ್ತದ ರೈತನಿಗೆ ಮಡಿಕೆ ಬೇಡ, ಚಪ್ಪಲಿ ಬೇಕು. ಹಣವಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕುಂಬಾರ ಮೊದಲು ಮಡಿಕೆ ಬಯಸುವ ಚಮ್ಮಾರನನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಬೇಕು. ಹಣ ಈ ತೊಂದರೆಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: In a barter economy goods are exchanged directly for goods. Trade then needs a double coincidence of wants: each person must want what the other offers, in the right quantity, at the same time. This makes exchange slow and costly. Money, accepted by everyone, removes this difficulty.
body.kn: ವಸ್ತು ವಿನಿಮಯ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಕನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸರಕಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಯಕೆಗಳ ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಬೇಕು. ಇದರಿಂದ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಕಷ್ಟಕರ. ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಪ್ಪುವ ಹಣ ಈ ತೊಂದರೆಯನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Double coincidence of wants is rare
Goods are hard to divide and store

narration.en: In a barter economy goods are exchanged directly for goods. Trade then needs a double coincidence of wants: each person must want what the other offers, in the right quantity, at the same time. This makes exchange slow and costly. Money, accepted by everyone, removes this difficulty.
narration.kn: ವಸ್ತು ವಿನಿಮಯ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಕನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸರಕಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಯಕೆಗಳ ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಬೇಕು. ಇದರಿಂದ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಕಷ್ಟಕರ. ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಪ್ಪುವ ಹಣ ಈ ತೊಂದರೆಯನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: First, money is a medium of exchange: we sell goods for money and use money to buy goods. Second, it is a unit of account: values of all goods are expressed in rupees. Third, it is a store of value: wealth can be held in money for the future. Fourth, it is a standard of deferred payments: loans and future payments are fixed in money terms.
body.kn: ಹಣದ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು: ವಿನಿಮಯ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮ, ಲೆಕ್ಕದ ಘಟಕ (ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ಮಾಪನ), ಮೌಲ್ಯದ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ, ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದೂಡಿದ ಪಾವತಿಗಳ ಮಾನದಂಡ.

Third, it is a store of value: wealth can be held in money for the future. Fourth, it is a standard of deferred payments: loans and future payments are fixed in money terms.

problem.en: Identify the function of money in each case: (a) Ravi sells his old cycle for ₹2,000 and buys books; (b) a menu card shows dosa at ₹60; (c) Meena keeps ₹5,000 at home for her sister's wedding next year; (d) a farmer agrees to repay a ₹50,000 loan after the harvest.

steps.en: (a) money is used to sell and then buy: medium of exchange.
(b) the dosa's value is stated in rupees: unit of account.
(c) money is held for future use: store of value.
(d) a future payment is fixed in money: standard of deferred payments.

answer.en: (a) medium of exchange, (b) unit of account, (c) store of value, (d) standard of deferred payments.
